statement.p: Autumn filled the gas tank in her car to {15\ {\rm gal}}\text{.} When the tank reaches {1\ {\rm gal}}\text{,} the low gas light will come on. On average, Autumns car uses {{\frac{4}{89}}\ {\rm gal}} per mile driven. How many miles will Autumns car be able to drive before the low gas light comes on?
